items.description: If Landlord repossesses the Tenant Space without terminating the Lease, Tenant must pay accrued rental and indebtedness plus Rent for the remainder of the Term, less net reletting proceeds.
items.span_text: Tenant shall be liable for and shall pay to Landlord all rental and other indebtedness accrued to the date of such repossession, plus Rent required to be paid by Tenant to Landlord during the remainder of the Term of this Lease until the expiration of the Term of this Lease
items.trigger: If Landlord elects to repossess the Tenant Space without terminating this Lease

items.description: Upon an Event of Default, Tenant must pay Landlord's reletting costs, property removal and storage costs, and enforcement expenses including attorneys' fees.
items.span_text: Upon an Event of Default, Tenant shall also be liable for and shall pay to Landlord, in addition to any sum provided to be paid pursuant to this Lease:

items.description: Past due rental and other payments accrue interest at the Default Rate from maturity until paid.
items.span_text: Past due rental and other past due payments shall bear interest from maturity at the Default Rate (as defined in Section 3.5 of this Lease) until paid.

items.description: Landlord must use reasonable efforts to relet the Tenant Space after Tenant vacates following termination due to an Event of Default.
items.span_text: Landlord agrees to use reasonable efforts to relet the Tenant Space after Tenant vacates the Tenant Space in the event that the Lease is terminated following an Event of Default by Tenant hereunder.
items.trigger: in the event that the Lease is terminated following an Event of Default by Tenant hereunder

items.description: Tenant must reimburse Landlord as Additional Rent for costs of curing Tenant's default or payment failure, plus an administrative fee, within ten days after demand.
items.span_text: Tenant shall be obligated to, and hereby agrees to, pay to Landlord as Additional Rent, within ten (10) days following Landlord’s demand therefor, all costs, expenses and disbursements (including actual attorneys’ fees) incurred by Landlord in taking such remedial action, plus an administrative fee of ten percent (10%) of such amount.
items.trigger: If Tenant should fail to make any payment (other than Base Rent) or cure any default hereunder within the time herein permitted

items.description: Landlord must furnish electricity to each listed suite sufficient to meet its Electricity Consumption Threshold.
items.span_text: Landlord shall (i) furnish electricity to Suite 1.5 sufficient to meet ECT-Suite 1.5, (ii) furnish electricity to Suite 1.5.1 sufficient to meet the ECT-Suite 1.5.1, (iii) furnish electricity to Suite 1.5.2 sufficient to meet the ECT-Suite 1.5.2, and (iv) furnish electricity to Suite 1.14A sufficient to meet the ECT-Suite 1.14A.

items.description: Landlord must furnish back-up power for the Premises sufficient to meet the Back-Up Power Specifications.
items.span_text: In addition, Landlord shall furnish back-up power for the Premises sufficient to meet the Back-Up Power Specifications.

items.description: Landlord represents that the Back-Up Power Specifications suffice to support the Datacenter's designed IT and HVAC loads during a utility outage.
items.span_text: Landlord hereby represents that the Back-Up Power Specifications are sufficient to support the Datacenter’s designed IT and HVAC system loads during a utility power outage.

items.description: Landlord must furnish HVAC so the Premises' average temperature and humidity meet the HVAC Specifications.
items.span_text: Landlord shall furnish HVAC to the Premises sufficient to cause the average temperature and humidity of the Premises (measured at the return air vents in the Premises) to meet the HVAC Specifications.
